| Command | Result | Details |

Tests 22–26 (new Slice 1 tests):

## Spec Compliance Matrix

| Req | Name | Status | Evidence |
|-----|------|--------|----------|
| REQ-S1-1 | Decision-Dir Gap Seam | PASS | Tests 22-25 pass; `_defaultResolveDecisionsDir`, `_defaultCheckDecisionsDir`, seams injected in `init()` params |
| REQ-S1-2 | i18n Notice Keys | PASS | Keys present in en.mjs (lines 166-167) and es.mjs (lines 151-152); hint contains `/project:bootstrap-adrs`; no hardcoding in gentle-ai.mjs; test 47 (parity) passes |
| REQ-S1-3 | Fresh-install Notice Assertion | STRUCTURAL PASS | `in-container.sh` [4] block present and correct; full execution requires fresh container |
| REQ-S2-1 | Command File Exists | PASS | File at `.claude/commands/project-bootstrap-adrs.md`, 581 lines, no `delegate_only` in frontmatter |
| REQ-S2-2 | Draft Destination (Tier 1) | STRUCTURAL PASS | Command preamble + Phase 2 explicitly write to `brain-drafts/` only; `brain/` forbidden in Phases 0-2; Agent E2E pending |
| REQ-S2-3 | Collision-safe ADR Numbering | STRUCTURAL PASS | Phase 0 Step 0.3: scan, max+1, zero-pad; Phase 2 sequentially assigns; covered topics skip slot, NO-SIGNAL consumes slot; Agent E2E pending |
| REQ-S2-4 | Descriptive+stub Draft Content | STRUCTURAL PASS | Template enforces Decision=facts, Context/Consequences=`<TODO>`; "Do NOT invent rationale" constraint explicit; Agent E2E pending |
| REQ-S2-5 | Draft Language | STRUCTURAL PASS | Phase 0 reads `docs.language` (default en); Phase 2 language rule enforced; Agent E2E pending |
| REQ-S3-1 | Per-ADR Review Flow | STRUCTURAL PASS | Phase 3: 4 choices (accept/edit/reject/accept-all); reject → no brain/ write; edit → re-present before final choice; Agent E2E pending |
| REQ-S3-2 | Tier 2 Write Gate | STRUCTURAL PASS | Phase 4 Path A: per-ADR Tier 2 prompt (confirm/skip); Path B: batched Tier 2 prompt (confirm/cancel); explicit pre-amble; Agent E2E pending |
| REQ-S3-3 | HOME.md Patch Safety | STRUCTURAL PASS | Two abort conditions (heading absent, no ADR link line); fail-safe: HOME.md untouched + report; Tier 2 gated; Agent E2E pending |
| REQ-S3-4 | Accept-all Gate | STRUCTURAL PASS | `reviewedConfirmed` state variable; decline if false; explicit unlock message; Agent E2E pending |
| REQ-S4-1 | Augment Mode | STRUCTURAL PASS | Phase 0 Step 0.4: keyword-match slug+H1 title against topic sets; Step 0.5: coverage assessment + user confirm; Agent E2E pending |
| REQ-S4-2 | Full-coverage Clean Exit | STRUCTURAL PASS | Step 0.5: empty `topicsToDraft` after confirm → exact "All starter ADR topics are already covered. No drafts needed." exit; Agent E2E pending |
| REQ-E-1 | Brain Write Gate Invariant | HOLDS | `gentle-ai.mjs` emits only `console.log()` — zero brain/ writes. All `brain/` writes are in Phase 4 behind explicit Tier 2 confirmation. All autonomous work is confined to `openspec/changes/auto-adrs/brain-drafts/`. Reject, NO-SIGNAL, cancel, and fail-safe abort paths all produce zero brain/ writes. |

---

## Issues

### CRITICAL

**C-1 (REQ-S2-2 through REQ-S4-2, REQ-E-1 partial)**: 11 manual E2E tasks unchecked  
Tasks 7.1-7.5, 9.1-9.6, 11.1-11.3 are open. Per skill rules, unchecked tasks are always CRITICAL.  
**Context**: these are the acknowledged non-automatable Agent E2E acceptance steps (spec G1). They cannot be run by `node --test` — they require invoking the conversational command in a Claude Code session against a consumer repo. The code authoring (Phases 6, 8, 10) is fully implemented and verified by structural review. The Tier 2 invariant holds by audit.  
**Resolution required**: Run the manual E2E checklist against a live consumer repo before merge. This was always the stated acceptance protocol.

### WARNING

None.

### SUGGESTION

**S-1 (REQ-S4-1)**: `language` keyword in Stack topic set can produce false positives  
`adr-0009-documentation-language-policy.md` matches "language" even though it is about docs language, not programming language. Documented known edge case (apply-progress). User can override via `include stack`. No code change needed; keyword heuristic is intentionally conservative + user-confirmed per design.

---

## Tier 2 Invariant Verdict

**HOLDS.** Audited all code paths introduced by this feature:
1. `gentle-ai.mjs` Step 4: `console.log()` only — no file writes of any kind.
2. `.claude/commands/project-bootstrap-adrs.md`:
   - Phases 0-2: writes only to `openspec/changes/auto-adrs/brain-drafts/`. Preamble says "never to brain/".
   - Phase 3: reads/rewrites only `brain-drafts/` on edit. No brain/ access.
   - Phase 4 Path A: each ADR write preceded by explicit "confirm/skip" Tier 2 prompt.
   - Phase 4 HOME.md (Path A): separate "confirm/skip" Tier 2 prompt.
   - Phase 4 Path B: single batched "confirm/cancel" Tier 2 prompt covering all files + HOME.md.
   - NO-SIGNAL, reject, cancel, and fail-safe abort paths: zero brain/ writes.

## Verdict

**PASS WITH WARNINGS (one CRITICAL — manual E2E pending)**

All automatable assertions pass. Tier 2 invariant holds. The only remaining gap is the manual E2E walkthrough of the conversational agent command (non-automatable by design, acknowledged in spec G1). This must be completed and documented before merging the tracker to main.

## GO / NO-GO

**Conditional GO**: implementation is complete, correct, and safe to merge after the manual E2E run is documented. The manual E2E is the acceptance gate for the command behavior (Slices 2-4), which cannot be proven by unit tests.
